context.title: Patient
context.description: The demographics of the virtual patient: name, patient ID, age (a duration such as P58Y), sex, race, and species and breed of an animal patient, followed by further demographic characteristics such as occupation or marital status.

context.title: Narrative
context.description: The VPDText elements: chief complaint, history, problems, allergies and narrative. Each has an id and a text type; its formatted text (an XHTML div with paragraphs, lists, images and media references) is edited on the XML page.

context.title: History
context.description: Interview items (a question the learner may ask and the patient's response) and the medications the patient takes, with dose, route, frequency and an optional vocabulary code.

context.title: Physical Exam
context.description: Physical examinations: the exam, the action of the virtual clinician, the finding, a description and the location on the body.

context.title: Diagnostic Tests
context.description: Diagnostic test results: test name, result, unit and normal range. A Data Availability Model can show results only if the learner ordered them (display ifrequested).

context.title: Diagnoses
context.description: Differential diagnoses with their likelihood, and the author's final diagnosis (Author diagnosis). Names may carry a vocabulary code (for example ICD-10).

context.title: Interventions
context.description: Interventions the learner may choose, how appropriate they are (always, ok, never, none), their results and an optional medication given.

context.title: Organization
context.description: A hierarchy of sections and items for authoring systems; each item refers to a data element by its id (idRef).

context.title: Activity Nodes
context.description: Node sections and their activity nodes. The first node of the file starts the activity; each node shows a DAM node (Content) and may have rules: counter actions, a conditional rule, probability and global navigation, and a node timer.

context.title: Links
context.description: The links between activity nodes: from ActivityNodeA to ActivityNodeB, with a label, an optional weighting (percent, for nodes with Probability on) and counter actions taken when the learner follows the link.

context.title: Counters and Timer
context.description: The counters of the activity (scores such as patient health or costs) with their initial values and rules, and the timer that runs through the whole activity.

context.title: DAM Nodes
context.description: DAM nodes group the data an activity node shows. Each item points to Virtual Patient Data (/VirtualPatientData/...) or to a media resource of the package (/manifest/resources/resource[@identifier='...']), says when it is displayed and may include other DAM nodes.
